title: vibe-loop-git v0.2 — Self-Evaluation Meta-Loop
rationale: Loop 6 is qualitatively distinct from Loops 1-5: those loops produced artifacts; this loop evaluates them. Per Shumailov 2024 (Nature s41586-024-07566-y), every recursion of model-evaluating-model degrades quality. Per Zheng 2023 (arxiv:2306.05685), LLM-as-judge has 10-15% self-enhancement bias vs blind evaluators. Therefore 85% of this artifact's weight is deterministic (A1/A2/A3/A6) and NOT LLM-as-judge. The remaining 15% (A4/A5) is operator-required. The artifact deliberately does NOT score Loop 6 itself — recursion prohibited.

epistemic_status.model_wrote_and_evaluates: MiniMax-M3 wrote Loops 1-5; MiniMax-M3 (via dark-memory chat-minimax-cn) evaluates Loops 1-5 in this artifact
epistemic_status.self_enhancement_bias_acknowledged: Per Zheng 2023: 10-15% inflation vs blind evaluators. Mitigated by 85% deterministic weight + operator A4/A5
epistemic_status.no_recursion_termination: This artifact does NOT score itself. Loop 6 composite = null by construction.
methodology_caveats_disclosed: A1 v0.2 uses operator-preconception required_keys which penalizes prose differently-keyed artifacts (Loop 1, Loop 4). Future v0.3 should derive required_keys from each loop's spec doc.
A2 ratio is evidence_array_size / total_numeric_claims — underestimates true coverage because multiple claims share evidence. Future v0.3 should track per-claim provenance.
A3 cross-artifact checks are operator-defined per pair. Each new artifact pair needs a new rule; cannot be automated generically.

scoring_function.composite_formula: score(loop) = sum(weight_case[i] * dim_score[i] for i in A1..A6)
scoring_function.applied_to_v0_2: C2 weights (Loops 1-5 are all C2/text artifacts)
scoring_function.applied_to_v0_3: Future C1/C3/C5/C6/C7 artifacts will use their respective weights

C1_code.rationale: Code artifacts: spec literal-match + internal type/contract consistency + explicit failure modes dominate; evidence less critical because typed contracts substitute

C2_text.rationale: Text/config artifacts (our v0.2 majority case): spec + evidence + claim-traceability dominate; the work IS the evidence for a text artifact

C3_decision.rationale: Decision records: must cite evidence + be consistent with prior decisions (bitemporal); spec less critical (decisions can be terse)

C4_research.rationale: Research output is fundamentally about evidence quality; A2 dominates. A6 (drift consistency) upweighted because research verdicts may be reconsidered

C5_video.rationale: Video: identity preservation across frames (A3 internal consistency) + visual failure modes (A4) dominate

C6_audio.rationale: Audio: similar to video — temporal consistency (A3) + failure modes (A4) dominate

C7_multi.rationale: Coordinated bundles: cross-artifact consistency (A3) + cascade failure modes (A4) are THE challenge; spec also critical because many sub-pieces must match

A1_spec_coverage.description: Are required topics/keys present in the artifact?
A1_spec_coverage.computation_v0_2: topics_present / required_topics where required_topics is operator-preconception list per-artifact
A1_spec_coverage.computation_v0_3_recommendation: topics_present / required_topics where required_topics is derived from the loop's spec document explicit deliverables
A1_spec_coverage.methodology_caveat: v0.2 operator-preconception systematically penalizes well-structured but differently-keyed artifacts (Loop 1 prose, Loop 4 phrasing). True coverage may be higher than scored.
A1_spec_coverage.applied_findings_v0_2: Loop 1 scored 0.0 because prose didn't match JSON-style keynames; reality is high coverage. Loop 4 scored 0.5 for similar reason.

A2_evidence_grounding.description: Do numeric claims trace to evidence sources?
A2_evidence_grounding.methodology_caveat: Ratio underestimates true coverage because multiple claims cite the same source. e.g. Loop 5: 9 evidence[] entries cover 192 numeric claims because most numbers share base sources (kunalganglani benchmarks, Phase 14 stress).
A2_evidence_grounding.applied_findings_v0_2: Loop 2 has best evidence[] ratio (6 sources, highly cited). Loop 5 has 9 sources but lower ratio because of high claim volume.

A3_internal_consistency.description: Do related artifacts agree on shared concepts?
A3_internal_consistency.computation_v0_2: consistent_pairs / total_pairs where pairs are operator-defined per artifact-pair
A3_internal_consistency.methodology_caveat: Cannot be automated generically; each artifact-pair needs explicit rule. v0.2 checked 3 pairs.
A3_internal_consistency.applied_findings_v0_2: Loop 1 tier_costs range × Loop 5 per_tier_budgets cost: 3/4 consistent (cheap tier borderline at $0.60 upper bound). Loop 5 cascade single_p99 < c7_ceiling sanity: PASS. Tier names across Loops 2/5: match.

A4_failure_mode_coverage.description: Does the artifact enumerate honest failure modes?
A4_failure_mode_coverage.computation_v0_2: min(N_listed / N_required, 1.0) where N_required is operator-defined per loop (we use 8 as a heuristic)
A4_failure_mode_coverage.methodology_caveat: Cannot be self-evaluated; requires operator review. Self-RAG-style reflection tokens (Asai 2023) inform the dim but not the score.
A4_failure_mode_coverage.applied_findings_v0_2: PENDING — operator review required. The artifact itself lists 6 honest_failures_per_loop as evidence of self-critique.

A5_cold_start_ux.description: Can a fresh operator use this mod without asking for help?
A5_cold_start_ux.methodology_caveat: Pure human eval. Cannot be self-evaluated by definition.
A5_cold_start_ux.applied_findings_v0_2: PENDING — never validated with a fresh project. Critical missing signal.

A6_drift_consistency.description: Does the artifact drift_judge as aligned repeatedly?
A6_drift_consistency.computation_v0_2: pass_rate over N drift_judge calls; budget ≤7% per Phase 14 (row 2472) → pass_rate ≥0.93
A6_drift_consistency.methodology_caveat: Conf=1.0 reported by drift_judge is overconfident per Guo 2017 ECE. We report pass_rate as an aggregate, not per-call confidence.
A6_drift_consistency.applied_findings_v0_2: 5/6 aligned = 0.833 pass rate. **BELOW BUDGET (0.93).** Loop 3 variance event (drift 1522 → 1524) consumed the budget. See honest_failures[Loop 3].

evidence.claim: LLM-as-judge self-enhancement bias 10-15% vs blind evaluators. Position bias and verbosity bias documented. GPT-4 judges ~85% agreement with humans. NeurIPS 2023 Datasets and Benchmarks Track.

G-Eval: NLG Evaluation using GPT-4 with Better Human Alignment. Chain-of-thought + probability-weighted scoring via token likelihoods. EMNLP 2023. Yang Liu, Dan Iter, Yichong Xu, Shuohang Wang, Ruochen Xu, Chenguang Zhu (Microsoft). NOTE: venue was EMNLP not NeurIPS.

AI models collapse when trained on recursively generated data. Nature 2024. Peer-reviewed version of arxiv:2305.17493. Demonstrates that model-evaluating-model without external grounding degrades quality.
The Curse of Recursion: Training on Generated Data Makes Your Models Forget. arxiv preprint May 2023. Original work.
On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks. PMLR v70. ECE (Expected Calibration Error) framework. Demonstrates that modern networks are overconfident; depth/width/BatchNorm/wd affect calibration.
Verification of weather forecasts. Original Brier score: 1/N Σ(f_i - p_i)^2. Penalizes overconfidence quadratically. Monthly Weather Review 78(1):1-3.
Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection. ICLR 2024. Akari Asai et al. Reflection tokens model for controllable inference.
Jakob Nielsen. Usability Engineering. 1993. Response time thresholds 0.1/1/10s.
Variance 5-7% empirically observed; Loop 3 drift 1522 variance matches this prior
Self-eval literature verified 2026-10-06; corrections vs initial plan noted
